actual_boolean_family: F(x,y)=(-1)^q(x) y_(M x), with binary physical x and sign data y indexed by all a-bit states; q has degree at most two over F2
parameter_domain: Exhaust n=0..3, a=0..2, every binary a by n matrix and every quadratic q modulo global sign. For n=4, a=0..2, use eight explicitly listed address maps and all 1024 quadratic q modulo global sign. Validate one repeated-control cancellation tower n=a=3, t=0..12, and one quadratic modulation tower n=4,a=2,t=0..6.
case_count: 4857 exhaustive small-cube cases plus 8192 four-control cases plus 20 tower checkpoints: 13069 total.
symmetry: Only global output sign omitted; it preserves squared spectrum and all physical influences. No equivalence reduction on matrices or quadratic forms.
arithmetic: Integer Walsh transforms; exact dyadic spectrum masses and Fraction influence; GF2 row reduction; entropy certified exactly from a flat spectrum with power-of-two support, without numerical logarithms.
memory_estimate: Under 20 MB: at most 256 truth-table entries and 256 Walsh integers per case, streamed summaries; no heavy job or memok gate needed.
independent_implementation: Truth-table evaluation and Walsh spectrum versus GF2 rank ledger; edge-count influence independently compared with spectral degree and coordinate derivative formula. Author self-check, not independent human review.
